title: OyatieTestStandard
description: Machine-readable unit/integration/e2e test standard evaluated as part of protected pull-request admission and runtime-promotion evidence.

_meta.current_authority_boundary: plain git + protected GitHub PRs; oya-ci-required is the sole merge-status authority; cloud-ci runtime-promotion claims remain held pending independently verified runtime evidence
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable unit/integration/e2e test standard evaluated by protected pull-request admission and runtime-promotion evidence.

tiers.purpose: Fast proof for pure logic and component behavior.
Boundary proof across ports/adapters/storage/contracts with deterministic local dependencies.
Provider/consumer schema parity for OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/Proto/Cedar/SQL contracts.
must_run_when: public API or event contract changed

tiers.purpose: User/workflow-level proof across preview/deployed composition, including web/mobile/desktop flows.
Invariant proof for parsers, serializers, codecs, state machines, and cross-pillar invariants.
Boundary probing for unsafe, FFI, public parsers/deserializers, and audit-chain parsers.

admission_algorithm: Compute semantic diff from AST/artifact index.
Map changed symbols to surfaces, languages, contracts, and generated clients.
Resolve required test tiers from tiers[].must_run_when and test-set-registry rows.
Reject a candidate pull-request head if required evidence is missing or stale after refresh onto the current protected base.
Convert CI/review failures to typed FixupTasks with affected symbol/test refs.
Hold runtime promotion until required tiers pass or a production-blocking gap is explicitly recorded.

flaky_policy.persistent_failure_policy: cannot convert to pass; create FixupTask or reject promotion

ast_requirement.minimum: AST or parser-backed semantic symbol ranges for supported source languages; JSON/YAML/TOML/OpenAPI/Cedar/SQL/CI use structural pointer symbols.
